summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature. Changes: rich/progress.py (private _BinaryFileReader and _ReaderContext helpers, module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file methods); tests/test_progress.py (about 20 new tests inserted before the __main__ block); docs/source/progress.rst (two subsections under Advanced usage); CHANGELOG.md (one Added entry, PR 1759). Nothing was run: no tests, mypy, or black, per instructions, so verification was by reading only. Open risks: the module-level open return suppression may be unused under strict mypy and should be removed if so; the TextIOWrapper buffer-protocol compatibility is unchecked; on Python 3.6 typing.IO abstract methods may block instantiating the reader (unverified). Nothing was committed.
